title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode11 Idols, Now and Forever

meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI - Flower Field

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Humhumm... Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Minori still seems to be enjoying that dream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
The rest of us are awake now...
But do you think she's still dreaming of us dancing on the rooftop?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She's probably just that happy about the four of us getting back together and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I think it's high time that we woke her up!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Rise and shine, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Mumble*
*Gasp*
H-Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Where am I...? Huh?
Miku? Wait, you're all here! Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness. You're all awake now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: How do you feel, Minori? Are you sore anywhere?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm okay!
But I was stuck in this really strange dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We were all doing different things, and we never met you or the others, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We were just telling them what happened. Believe it or not, we all had the same dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were all doing our best having taken different paths...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But we had to content with things not going quite the way we hoped, or having to suppress our true selves and our true feelings. We were dealing with internal struggles and other painful emotions.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you think caused us to have that dream...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, the black fragments which were stuck to the tree seem to have been behind that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, speaking of the tree, what happ—
Wow! It's grown this big?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's the thing. Right before you woke up, Minori, the tree absorbed all of those black fragments. They're gone now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And then, it grew really, really, big!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Those fragments really were strange.
I mean, you all fell asleep after touching them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Luka said that they might've been fragments of feelings... But if she's right, what feelings caused them to manifest?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I don't know... But a part of me was always anxious while we were in that dream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was finally able to pass an audition and become an idol like I always wanted, but things didn't go all that well...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I kept wondering if I'd ever be able to spread hope to people as an idol the way Haruka did.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I felt that the entire time as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I felt anxiety about whether I'd ever become the idol that I wanted to be, as well as guilt and regret about my original decision to quit.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means those sorts of feelings may've been involved.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't say for certain, but those sorts of negative feelings may've coalesced to form those black fragments...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which would explain why you all ended up having that terrible dream.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that dream also helped me realize something important!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Something important?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Even if we're pursuing different paths in life, no matter how hard things get...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll all still want to give hope to others!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
...
Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We realized just how important that is to us. It never went away regardless of how hard we tried to suppress it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Right. I also remembered just how much MORE MORE JUMP! means to me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm able to spread hope while just being myself because all of you accept me for who I am.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah... We've been able to support each other and make up for each others' shortcomings because we're working together as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As idols who spread hope.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Girls...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You two look like you're ready to cry, Miku, Rin.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Th-That's because...!
After hearing what happened, I'm really glad that they all met...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, why aren't you guys including yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Remember what we said that other time?! You guys are all members of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even during that dream, I could hear you guys trying to cheer us up.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your guys' empathy and support mean so much to us that, even while we were dreaming, you were able to reach us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We wouldn't have been able to make it this far without you guys. So, once again, I'm really, really glad that you're all here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: With this group of people, we should be able to go after any dream we like. So...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Let's do it...
Let's become idols who can spread lots of hope to lots of people!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, on that note, why don't we do our usual thing...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Yeah, let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You'll all join us, yes, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of course!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More and more songs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: More and more energy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More and more hope!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: May our songs reach more, more, more people!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE...

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: JUMP!
